_hand_authored: The @azure/mcp server is a .NET tool that did not emit an MCP handshake under piped stdio in the build harness (the Node-based backends enumerated fine). This is a REPRESENTATIVE subset of the documented Azure MCP (azmcp_*) tool surface so the merged tools/list is non-empty. Run `python hub.py --refresh azure` in the environment where @azure/mcp starts cleanly to replace this with the live schema. The az_account_* switching tools work regardless (they drive the az CLI, and `az login` is present).

tools.name: azmcp_subscription_list
tools.description: List the Azure subscriptions available to the signed-in identity (`az login`).

tools.name: azmcp_group_list
tools.description: List resource groups in a subscription.

tools.name: azmcp_bestpractices_get
tools.description: Get Azure best-practices guidance for secure, well-architected resource use.

tools.name: azmcp_extension_az
tools.description: Run an arbitrary Azure CLI (`az`) command and return its output.

command.description: The az command line, e.g. 'vm list -o table'

tools.name: azmcp_extension_azd
tools.description: Run an Azure Developer CLI (`azd`) command (init/up/deploy/down).

tools.name: azmcp_storage_account_list
tools.description: List Storage accounts in a subscription.

tools.name: azmcp_storage_blob_container_list
tools.description: List blob containers in a Storage account.

tools.name: azmcp_storage_blob_list

tools.name: azmcp_cosmos_account_list

tools.name: azmcp_cosmos_database_list
